Level up to unlock cooler, more expensive items!

🔵 4 in 5 for a blue (79.92%)
🟣 1 in 6 for a purple (15.98%)

Thanks for playing!

scripts.title: GEM Aura
scripts.features:

The ultimate automation and inventory management suite designed specifically for Case Haven. Streamline your gameplay with a fully featured case opening utility that automatically detects all available cases directly from the server storage, allowing you to select any case and open them in bulk quantities ranging from 1 to 10 at a time. Tailor your farm speed using the built-in delay slider to ensure optimal execution without triggering server timeouts, or execute quick single-item purchases on demand.

Take full control of your in-game economy with the integrated Smart Auto-Sell System. When enabled, the script inspects every dropped item in real time, calculating its precise value based on float conditions ranging from Factory New to Battle-Scarred, as well as special modifiers including StatTrak multipliers and Blue Gem patterns. Items falling below your personal auto-sell value threshold are automatically sold off instantly, securing valuable drops while automating trash disposal. Complete with full configuration saving powered by the Rayfield interface, your settings remain intact across all game sessions for an effortless AFK farming experience.
